# tests/fixtures — TEST DATA, not an example to copy

⛔ **Nothing in here is a template for a real house.** These files exist so the
suite has something fixed to assert against: names, prose and values are chosen
to be boring, stable and easy to grep for, not to be good.

`world_v1.json` is the reference world the world-loader tests read. If you are
looking for something to start a house from, it is `skel/` — the shipped
skeleton, with `[bracketed]` placeholders the engine refuses to boot on until
they are filled in.
